Description: Time series of permittivity at Marquardt study area, retrieved from Profile Probes and Theta Probes

Provider.Name: Till Francke
Provider.Institution: University of Potsdam, Environmental Sciences & Geography

Citation.Info: These files are part of the dataset published along with the data paper mentioned below.
Citation.cite-as: Heistermann, M., Francke, T., Scheiffele, L., Dimitrova Petrova, K., Budach, C., Schrön, M., Trost, B., Rasche, D.,  Güntner, A.,Döpper, V., Förster, M., Köhli, M., Angermann, L., Antonoglou, N., Zude-Sasse, M. and Oswald, S.: Three years of soil moisture observations by a dense cosmic-ray neutron sensing cluster at an agricultural research site in north-east Germany, Earth Syst. Sci. Data, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2023-19, 2023

Further technical details: Time series of permittivity (epsilon) measured with PR2-profile probes and ThetaProbes.
Sensor locations are contained in sm_locations.txt.

Raw data (recorded as epsilon, theta_default or voltage) was converted back to voltage and corrected using  two-point sensor-specific-calibrations. The resulting corrected voltage was then converted to epsilon using manufacturer's specifications (#Mq_profile).
The column names hold the depth of the respective sensors below ground in cm. For example, column eps40 would indicate the permittivity (epsilon) values at a depth of 50 cm.
The permittivity measured with TDR100 probes was not calibrated using a sensor-specific-calibration. Instead, the manufacturers' calibration was used.
